entries.description: stageMarkerPattern regex (──.*──) looks for literal stage markers in wrapper .md files, but wrappers delegate ceremony rendering to the Go runtime (aether ceremony spawn-plan/wave-start/worker-complete/closeout). Stage markers have never existed in the wrapper markdown -- they are runtime-rendered output. The check produces 5 false-positive warnings for build, continue, init, seal, and plan.
entries.suggestion: Either remove checkStageMarkers from scanCeremonyIntegrity (wrappers are not supposed to contain stage markers), or change it to verify that wrappers reference the runtime ceremony commands (spawn-plan, wave-start, worker-complete, closeout) instead of looking for literal ── markers.

entries.description: emojiPattern regex [\x{1F300}-\x{1FAFF}] misses emojis outside that Unicode range. Six command emojis fall outside this range: entomb (U+26B0), insert-phase (U+2795), quick (U+26A1), run (U+26A1), verify-castes (U+2713), shelf-promote (U+2B06). These wrappers have emojis in their descriptions but the medic reports them as missing.
entries.suggestion: Extend the emojiPattern regex to cover Miscellaneous Symbols (U+2600-U+26FF), Dingbats (U+2700-U+27BF), and Miscellaneous Symbols and Arrows (U+2B00-U+2BFF) ranges. Or use a more comprehensive Unicode emoji property match.

entries.description: 9 YAML source files (and their generated wrappers) lack the expected emoji in their description field: queen-compose, reference-index, reference-list, reference-match, shelf-add, shelf-dismiss, shelf-list, shelf-promote, shelf. The runtime commandEmojiMap defines emojis for all of these commands.
entries.suggestion: Add the matching commandEmojiMap emoji to the description field in each YAML source file, then regenerate the Claude and OpenCode wrappers.

entries.description: commandEmojiMap and casteEmojiMap are the ground truth for ceremony emojis. The medic check correctly uses these maps to verify wrapper consistency. The data is authoritative and correctly maintained.
entries.suggestion: No change needed. This is reference evidence for the investigation.
